mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate directly increases discount rates for equity valuation, compressing price-to-earnings multiples and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically triggers a recessionary outlook and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a contraction in consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a higher federal funds rate directly increases discount rates for equity valuation, compressing price-to-earnings multiples and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production directly reflects robust manufacturing and economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which typically precedes a broader economic slowdown and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in employment growth and rise in unemployment signals a severe labor market contraction, which typically triggers recessionary fears and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters), a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% in the current quarter) signals an impending economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.5% and the prior two quarters had growth above 2.5%.
